name: B10-0528/2025 (S&D) – Escalating repression of the Baha’is in Iran
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalating repression of the Baha’is in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on Iran to stop persecuting the Baha'i religious minority. It condemns arrests, unfair trials, property seizures and hate speech against them. It asks Iran to free named prisoners, return confiscated property, scrap the 1991 "Baha'i Question" policy and officially recognise the Baha'i faith. It also urges the European Union to raise these abuses with Iran, support United Nations monitors and help persecuted communities. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- Nothing changes in law; the Parliament only states its position and makes demands.
- It targets Iran's treatment of Baha'is and other religious minorities.
- Next, the text goes to Iran's government, the EU and the United Nations.
